item.title: Empty Bowls Houston at The Market at River Oaks District
item.description:
Sunday, August 23, 2026 at 11 AM

Location: The Market at River Oaks, 4444 Westheimer, Houston, TX, 77027, United States

Empty Bowls Houston will be at the The Market at River Oaks District Sunday, August 23 from 11 am to 3 pm at River Oaks District, 4444 Westheimer, 77027 Happy summer, friends! Empty Bowls Houston is happy to announce that we will be “popping up” at one of Houston’s newest farmers markets, The Market at River Oaks District! We will have a selection of bowls for sale and a live pottery demo on the potters’ wheel. Come shop for farm-fresh goodies and other local food products and, of course, our amazing bowls made by local artists to benefit Houston Food Bank!

From Houston Food Bank

item.description:

item.title: National Voter Registration Day
item.description:
Tuesday, September 15, 2026 at 12 AM

Location: Houston Food Bank East Branch, 535 Portwall Street, Houston, TX, 77029, United States

Did you know that on Tuesday, September 15th, it’s National Voter Registration Day! At Houston Food Bank, we care about having your voice heard, and we are proud to provide the opportunity for you to register to vote on National Voter Registration Day! We are partnering with Harris County Tax Office and the National Voter Registration Day organization to serve as a site for Voter Registration at our Portwall location. You are eligible to register to vote if: You are a United States citizen; You are a resident of the county where you submit the application; You are at least 17 years and 10 months old on the date your voter registration application is submitted, and you are 18 years of age on Election Day. You are not a convicted felon (you may be eligible to vote if you have completed your sentence, probation, and parole); and You have not been declared by a court exercising probate jurisdiction to be either totally mentally incapacitated or partially mentally incapacitated without the right to vote.
